scope: Supplemental isolated follow-up; development only, motivated by initial BGE result. No independent acceptance claim.
hypothesis: BGE relevance plus a cheap incidental/measurement veto may reduce false positives without requiring an explicit foreground predicate.
gate: Reject candidate occurrences whose frozen structural score is below zero. All other candidates retain their BGE cosine score.
selection: Same twelve domain folds, confidence grid and precision gates. Cosine thresholds are zero plus raw BGE unlabeled deciles. No no-filter fallback; negative rule veto always applies.
changes_after_scoring: None authorized; preserve failure if any.
